facts.fact: 又下六英寸雪——他知道雪会来，他准备好了
facts.anchor: Another six inches of snow this week. It’s early, but I knew it would come.

facts.fact: 雪给 Firefleet 带来平静：一切干净洁白，倒下的树顶着雪帽
facts.anchor: It felt as if the snow had brought a kind of peace to Firefleet.

facts.fact: 他被迫绕屋走圈，像监狱院子里的囚犯，一次十到二十圈
facts.anchor: he had been forced to limit his walks to circling the house like a convict in the prison yard, ten or twenty laps at a time

facts.fact: 他自语：我独自一人在雪球里，在我自己的私人世界
facts.anchor: I am alone in the snow globe, he thought, here in my own private world.

facts.fact: 他想：雪像赦免——赦免暗示罪，他不知罪从何来
Arthur 日记 2019-10-29：雾大如岛，从 Old Peak 到 Firefleet 线路断了
facts.anchor: There’s so much fog today that we might be on an island. Everything is gone. From Old Peak to Firefleet, the line is closed.

facts.fact: Benn 书尾声：我们是这里最新的新来者——土地比我们古老得多
facts.anchor: We are the newest of newcomers here

facts.fact: 他堆的雪人原本面向房子，现在转向了另一边
facts.anchor: The snowman he’d built facing the house was now facing the other way.

facts.fact: 一只步态如舞的狐狸诡异掠过积雪围栏——步态像 ch13 雾中女孩
facts.anchor: An animal – a fox, perhaps – quickly skirted the snow-covered fence. He only saw it for a beat, and yet its movement disturbed him. There was something uncanny about the speed with which it had vanished out of sight. Something about its dancing gait, like no animal he knew.

facts.fact: 窗外死灰的天空暗下来，本季第一场真正的风暴逼近
facts.anchor: while outside, the dead sky darkened towards the first real storm of the season.
